<parameter=code>
# Let me try clicking the upper red button to see its effect
# Save current state
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_colored_cells(ascii_lines):
    cells = []
    for r in range(15, 50):
        for c in range(10, 55):
            ch = ascii_lines[r][c]
            if ch not in ('c', 'G', 'g', 'w', 'B', 'R', 'N', 'Y'):
                cells.append((r, c, ch))
    return sorted(cells)

before = get_colored_cells(ascii_lines)

# Click upper red button at (16, 19)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 19}])

after = get_colored_cells(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'))

before_set = set(before)
after_set = set(after)

# Find changed cells
changed = []
for (r, c, new_ch) in after_set - before_set:
    for (r2, c2, old_ch) in before_set:
        if r == r2 and c == c2:
            changed.append((r, c, old_ch, new_ch))
            break

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"\nChanged cells ({len(changed)}):")
for r, c, old_ch, new_ch in sorted(changed):
    print(f"  ({r},{c}): {old_ch} -> {new_ch}")

# Check appeared/disappeared
appeared = [(r, c, ch) for (r, c, ch) in after_set - before_set if not any(r==r2 and c==c2 for (r2, c2, _) in before_set)]
disappeared = [(r, c, ch) for (r, c, ch) in before_set - after_set if not any(r==r2 and c==c2 for (r2, c2, _) in after_set)]
print(f"\nAppeared: {appeared}")
print(f"Disappeared: {disappeared}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
